comment.comment:
Derek Mercer represents the other side of the tokenized movement/cult thesis.

What does almost every successful cult, movement or religion have in common? An influential figurehead. Someone people idolise, identify with and rally behind.

Throughout history, influential figures have built entire movements around their personalities, ideas and beliefs. From religious leaders to cultural icons and internet personalities, these individuals become symbols of something bigger than themselves.

Think Satoshi, Steve Jobs or Zyzz. Different figures, different movements, but the same underlying psychology. They give people something to believe in, an identity to associate with and a community to belong to.

I think Derek has the potential to become an AI native version of this. A digital figurehead capable of building a movement around a shared identity, culture and set of ideals.

It’s Murad’s cult/movement thesis × Ansem’s social thesis wrapped into one.
